cases.label: Invoices (horizontal)
cases.hard: 100+ rows x 12 columns - needs multi-page pagination with the header row repeated on every page.

cases.label: Operations log (wide + long)
cases.hard: 181 rows x 15 columns - many rows AND wide; both axes paginate.

cases.label: 24 wide columns
cases.hard: 24 columns with long header names - overflows a single page; must split horizontally and stay legible.

cases.label: 35 columns (extreme)
cases.hard: 35 columns - the widest case; an extreme horizontal split into many labelled sections.

cases.label: Contacts (email / phone / company)
cases.hard: 16 typed columns that each need a minimum readable width (email, phone, company) - splitting without clipping is the test.

cases.label: Unicode / accents
cases.hard: Non-ASCII values and headers - font fallback and width safety (no clipping / replacement chars).

cases.label: One giant text column
cases.hard: A single very long free-text column - overflow, wrapping and row-height limits.
